data.one_liner: Manages transactions, wallets, and crypto operations on the TON network.
data.what_it_does: Ton Dart streamlines transaction management, cryptographic operations, and interaction with TonApi and TonCenter RPC APIs within the TON network. It provides comprehensive support for basic wallets, highload wallets, jetton tokens, NFTs, and BOC serialization.
use_when: Building a Flutter or Dart application that interacts with the TON blockchain
Managing TON wallet contracts, sending transfers, and handling Jettons or NFTs
Communicating with TonApi and TonCenter JSON-RPC endpoints
avoid_when: Working with non-TON blockchains such as Ethereum or Solana
Needing high-level UI components or ready-made wallet widgets
strengths: Comprehensive support for TON-specific contracts including basic wallets, highload wallets, jettons, and NFTs
Built-in BOC serialization and ED25519 cryptographic transaction signing
Integration capabilities with TonApi and TonCenter RPC
weaknesses: Requires familiarity with TON-specific concepts, TonApi, and TonCenter RPC APIs
Niche ecosystem focused strictly on the TON network
